title: Specified system projection and graph-refinement composition words
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and simultaneous system operations $o$ with compositors $c$, open comparisons $a$, canonical bridge $b$ and proper/open coherence $q$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge, def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. For a compactification $d=(i_d,g_d)$ of $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], put $\operatorname{support}_d=i_{d,!};g_{d,*}$ on derived strict semilinear coefficient systems. For a refinement $r:d\to e$, define $\operatorname{refinement}_r:\operatorname{support}_e\to\operatorname{support}_d$ as the composite of the canonical identity direct-image inverse, the proper/open mate $q.\gamma(i_d,1_X,r,i_e)$, the proper compositor, and the equality transport $r;g_e=g_d$. If $f$ is quasi-compact, use its canonical graph common refinement $d\wedge e$ and define $\operatorname{change}_{d,e}(M)=\operatorname{refinement}_{\mathrm{infFst}}(M);\operatorname{inverseOnDomain}(\operatorname{refinement}_{\mathrm{infSnd}}(M))$, where inverseOnDomain is the actual categorical inverse for an isomorphism, and the zero morphism otherwise. For a compatible triangle $T$ [def-pur-compatible-compactification-triangle], define $\operatorname{triangleWord}_T$ by whiskering its intrinsic proper/open mate with the first open extension and last proper direct image, then applying the open and proper compositors and the equations $T.i_q,T.p_g$. Define compositorAlong by these same four factors for an explicit triangle parameter. For compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_{gf}$ of quasi-compact maps $f,g,gf$, define $\alpha_{g,f,M}$ by change from $c_f,c_g$ to the canonical compatible triangle, its triangleWord, and change to $c_{gf}$. Define $\operatorname{projection}_d$ as the specified proper-counit projection followed by the open tensor comparison and pullback-compositor identification. Finally, leftMap is the two successive projections followed by $\alpha$ and the inverse pullback compositor; rightMap is $\alpha\otimes1$ followed by the composite projection. Tensor and pullback are the fixed derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Every composition is in the simultaneous system presentation and uses its specified equality transports; these are the unchanged explicit constructions extracted from the parent module.

lean.statement:
def compositor (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    (q : ProperOpenCoherence l E o c a b)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    (M : System l E X) :
    (support l E o cg).obj ((support l E o cf).obj M) ⟶ (support l E o cfg).obj M
